programs.title: Song Dynasty Poetry: Beauty Across Time Ep.6
programs.desc: Through the lens of Song dynasty poetry, this documentary brings to life the era's great poets, their works, and the stories behind them. By delving into their values and worldview, it reveals the deeper spirit within the culture, resulting in a work that is at once thoughtful, artistic, and deeply human.

programs.title: A Xinchou Mystery Ep.1
programs.desc: The 1901 explosion at the Hanyang Gunpowder Factory was the first major industrial accident after the Qing government adopted Western technology. This documentary uncovers the corruption and political infighting behind the death of Xu Jianyin, and the perilous investigation that followed.

programs.title: Hermit Master Ep.4
programs.desc: This documentary tracks a three-year journey spanning tens of thousands of kilometers. Adopting a rational and scientific perspective, it interprets the origins of traditional Chinese martial arts and reveals the little-known inheritance and secrets of kung fu.
